primary_metric: supported requested-label match rate including abstention and failed calls
success_rule: at least 14 of 15 for every model; every failed, unknown, or mismatched run remains in the denominator
secondary_rules: report enrolled and supported operating points separately
all frozen hashes and provenance values remain constant
compare TraceOne one-call with ModelTrace one-call and disjoint three-call decisions on the same untouched responses
truth_limitation: requested route labels are not independent ground truth for served weights
